correctness.rationale: The formula follows from exact intrinsic facet volumes using spanning-tree incidence determinants and minimal bonds; in a unicyclic graph the bonds are exactly bridges and pairs of cycle edges. A strict cycle-length lower bound rules out length>=4; strict concavity and an explicit nonleaf bridge penalty restrict the first two levels to leaf-loaded triangles; integer majorization proves uniqueness and exact sharp gap. Exhaustive small-graph and direct convex-hull checks validate normalization.
